Pinned commit: 0da23b9b6c82af5a4d2605671f503a9c2aaa239e
Original file: addons/springdamper/code/SpringDamper.gd
Retrieved 2026-09-25. See accompanying LICENSE.txt for complete terms.
Upstream credits Ryan Juckett's damped springs derivation:
https://www.ryanjuckett.com/damped-springs/

Local changes: removed the global class_name to avoid host-project collisions;
changed Object to RefCounted to release the two per-body spring instances
automatically. The analytic motion equations are unchanged.

Used for soft-packaging grip recovery, transient food contact deformation,
and the reduced single-mode reaction of contained liquid to hand acceleration.
This utility is not a rigid-body or fluid physics engine. Godot's existing
MIT-licensed 2D engine still solves rigid collisions and continuous detection.
No Rapier or Salva binary or source is included.
